question: How many members are enrolled in each college?
SQL: SELECT T2.college, COUNT(*) AS num_members FROM member AS T1 JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id GROUP BY T2.college

question: List the top 5 positions held by the most members.
SQL: SELECT position FROM member GROUP BY position ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many members are there per department?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members, T2.department FROM member AS T1 JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id GROUP BY T2.department

question: Which events have more than 5 attendees?
SQL: SELECT T2.event_name FROM attendance AS T1 JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id GROUP BY T2.event_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

question: How many employees work in each position?
SQL: SELECT T2.positiontitle, COUNT(*) AS num_employees FROM employee AS T1 JOIN position AS T2 ON T1.positionID = T2.positionID GROUP BY T2.positiontitle

question: What is the total salary expenditure per position?
SQL: SELECT T2.positiontitle, SUM(CAST(T1.salary AS REAL)) AS total_salary FROM employee AS T1 JOIN position AS T2 ON T1.positionID = T2.positionID GROUP BY T2.positiontitle ORDER BY total_salary DESC

question: List the top 10 airports by number of flight departures.
SQL: SELECT ORIGIN, COUNT(*) AS num_departures FROM Airlines GROUP BY ORIGIN ORDER BY num_departures DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which airlines had the highest average departure delay?
SQL: SELECT T2.Description, ROUND(AVG(T1.DEP_DELAY), 2) AS avg_delay FROM Airlines AS T1 JOIN "Air Carriers" AS T2 ON T1.OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID = T2.Code GROUP BY T2.Description ORDER BY avg_delay DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many transactions are there for each operation type in the trans table?
SQL: SELECT operation, COUNT(*) AS num_transactions FROM trans GROUP BY operation ORDER BY num_transactions DESC

question: What is the total revenue generated per product category?
SQL: SELECT T2.Category, ROUND(SUM(T1.Sales), 2) AS total_revenue FROM central_superstore AS T1 JOIN product AS T2 ON T1."Product ID" = T2."Product ID" GROUP BY T2.Category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
